summary: June payrolls came in at just 57,000 — well below expectations — but with inflation running hot, all eyes are now on Tuesday's June CPI print, the last major inflation read before the July 29 FOMC decision.
tweet: June CPI — the last major inflation read before the July 29 FOMC decision — lands Tuesday July 14, with rate hike odds surging; big bank earnings open the same morning, pulling sentiment in two directions.
